home.title: An umbrella for three specialised companies, and AI transformation for businesses.
home.body: Graphics House, Bees Motion and Turriva operate under Tasami Group — each with its own name and discipline. Under the group name, Tasami AI converts companies to work with artificial intelligence.
home.storyTitle: One umbrella. Three companies. A transformation offer.
home.storyBody: Tasami Group stands behind Graphics House, Bees Motion and Turriva. Each company keeps its name, its market and its expertise. The group brings them together when a project needs more than one discipline, and raises the standard of the work under a single umbrella.
home.storyBody2: Under its own name, the group also offers Tasami AI: converting companies to work with artificial intelligence, from the first assessment to a team that uses it every day.
home.aiBandBody: We turn communication, sales, operations and reporting into intelligent systems that cut repetitive work and show a clear result — not a demo deck.
home.companiesTitle: Different brands. Different expertise. One group.
home.companiesBody: Three specialised companies under the Tasami Group umbrella. Each keeps its market. The group connects them when the work requires it.
home.umbrellaTitle: Tasami Group is the umbrella. The three companies sit under it.
home.umbrellaBody: A developer launching a project may need launch visuals from Graphics House, a campaign from Bees Motion, and the sales gallery from Turriva. Tasami Group coordinates that as one engagement — and Tasami AI transforms how the company itself works.

sales-automation.name: Sales & outreach automation
sales-automation.summary: Lead capture and follow-up that does not drop requests.
sales-automation.problem: Sales teams lose hours every day on repetitive replies and manual follow-up, so opportunities cool before a meeting is set.
sales-automation.build: We build a classify-and-follow path across WhatsApp, web, and email, connected to your CRM.
sales-automation.deliver: Classification rules, controlled auto-replies, an opportunity board, and operational handover.

faqs.q: Does this replace the sales team?
faqs.a: No. It removes repetitive work while decisions stay with your team.

faqs.q: Does it work with our WhatsApp?
faqs.a: Yes. We design around your current channels where possible.

faqs.q: When do we see first results?
faqs.a: Usually during the prototype weeks, then we expand after validation.

faqs.q: How much does this service cost?
faqs.a: Cost depends on project scope and your current systems. We define it with you in a free diagnosis meeting, then you receive a written proposal with a fixed fee.

about.title: About us
about.body: Tasami Group is the umbrella of three specialised companies: Graphics House, Bees Motion and Turriva. Each keeps its name, its market and its expertise. The group connects them when a project needs more than one discipline, and raises the standard of the work under a single roof.
about.body2: We speak to executives and business owners in Saudi Arabia and the Gulf, often starting with developer and real-estate needs where communication, sales, and operations repeat every week.
about.body3: Under its own name, the group offers Tasami AI: converting companies to work with artificial intelligence, from the first assessment to a team that uses it every day.

contact.title: Contact us
contact.body: Write to Tasami Group. We will route you to Graphics House, Bees Motion or Turriva — or open a Tasami AI diagnosis if the need is transformation.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.body: We only collect data needed to respond to contact and diagnosis requests. We do not sell your data. We handle data under the principles of Saudi Arabia’s Personal Data Protection Law (PDPL).
